WITH filtered_jobs AS (
    SELECT job_id, salary_year_avg
    FROM job_postings_fact
    WHERE job_title_short = 'Data Analyst'
        AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
        AND job_work_from_home = 1
),
skill_freq AS (
    SELECT sjd.skill_id, COUNT(*) as skill_count
    FROM filtered_jobs fj
    JOIN skills_job_dim sjd ON fj.job_id = sjd.job_id
    WHERE sjd.skill_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sjd.skill_id
),
top_skills AS (
    SELECT skill_id
    FROM skill_freq
    ORDER BY skill_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT fj.job_id, fj.salary_year_avg
FROM filtered_jobs fj
WHERE fj.job_id IN (
    SELECT sjd.job_id
    FROM skills_job_dim sjd
    WHERE sjd.skill_id IN (SELECT skill_id FROM top_skills)
)

WITH base_jobs AS (
    SELECT 
        job_id,
        salary_year_avg
    FROM job_postings_fact
    WHERE job_title_short = 'Data Analyst'
      AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND job_work_from_home = 1
),
job_skills AS (
    SELECT 
        j.job_id,
        s.skills
    FROM base_jobs j
    JOIN skills_job_dim sj ON j.job_id = sj.job_id
    JOIN skills_dim s ON sj.skill_id = s.skill_id
),
skill_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        skills,
        COUNT(*) as skill_freq
    FROM job_skills
    GROUP BY skills
),
ranked_skills AS (
    SELECT 
        skills,
        skill_freq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY skill_freq DESC) as rn
    FROM skill_counts
),
top3_skills AS (
    SELECT skills
    FROM ranked_skills
    WHERE rn <= 3
),
filtered_jobs AS (
    SELECT salary_year_avg
    FROM base_jobs
    WHERE job_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT job_id
        FROM job_skills
        WHERE skills IN (SELECT skills FROM top3_skills)
    )
)
SELECT AVG(salary_year_avg) as overall_avg_salary FROM filtered_jobs
